title: openbao-config-mto-bootstrap values
description: Constrains only the switches whose values are consumed as string comparisons downstream, where a near-miss (yes / on / True / 1) would otherwise disable an integration silently. Everything else is intentionally unconstrained: this chart is wrapped by other charts and the schema must not become a second place to keep in sync. The exceptions, each for the reason given on its key: platformPki.mode and sync.mode are enums, parent.pki.roles is checked structurally, the IdP client values under parent.sso (clientId, both clientSecretRef keys, audience) must not be empty, and parent.sso.sharedSpace is closed. The accepted forms mirror templates/_helpers.tpl exactly -- a boolean, or the strings "true"/"false" so that --set-string and wrapper charts passing stringified values still work. If you change one, change the other.

boolish.description: true or false, as a YAML boolean or as the quoted string "true"/"false". Anything else (yes, on, off, 1, 0, True, TRUE) is rejected, because it would be read as "not enabled" without warning.

mode.description: "root" is an online self-signed platform root; "intermediate" keeps the root offline. Enumerated because the template matches "intermediate" exactly, so any other value would otherwise render an online root.

eso.description: A string, not a boolean: "enabled" or "disabled". true/false/yes/on are rejected.

sharedSpace.description: Closed: a misspelled key inside it (enable, Enabled) fails the render instead of leaving the login off without a word. A misspelled sharedSpace key itself is not caught, because parent.sso stays open for wrapper charts; it reads as off, the safe direction.

allowedRedirectUris.description: Tenant chart sso.allowedRedirectUris. Empty means the tenant chart's default loopback callback.

pki.description: Tenant PKI settings rendered literally into the child valuesTemplate (install-wide, not per-tenant parameters).

roles.description: Tenant chart pki.roles. Empty means the tenant chart's own default catalog. Validated structurally here only — the per-field constraints (and additionalProperties:false, which is what catches a misspelled pass-through field) live in the tenant chart's schema, and duplicating them here would let the two drift.

token.description: Tenant chart `token`. Install-wide. Empty means the tenant chart's own defaults apply. period is deliberately not exposed: bao silently ignores it on a batch token.

parent.description: Parent Template defaults, passed through to every child TI. REQUIRED: a values file that nulls it deletes the key (helm drops null keys before schema validation), and every .Values.parent.<x> read then nil-pointers the whole bootstrap render with a Go template stack trace instead of naming the value.

mode.description: Drift protection. Unquoted on/yes/off parse as YAML booleans and are rejected -- quote the value.

safety.description: Deletion-policy posture for the platform-PKI CRs and (via the child Templates) every per-tenant CR. Cluster-global.

deletionProtection.description: true (default): retained on CR delete/rename; false: destroyed.

grantDeletionProtection.description: false (default): grants deleted on CR delete (revocation); true: grants retained.
